description: H15: Metric observability — counter (eval count), gauge (cache size), histogram (latency distribution with linearBoundaries), snapshot (read all). 59/59 tests, 15 hypotheses, 15 v4 modules. Formula DSL spike complete.

Session resume — re-confirmed 62/62 green. Wall 929ms (variance from 838 last run). No code change.

H17: Effect.timeout + Fiber.interrupt for runaway formula cancellation. H18: Semaphore for concurrent eval throttling (peak ≤ N). Effect.fork→Effect.forkChild in v4! 67/67 tests, 18 hypotheses, 18 v4 modules.
H19: Pool for WASM instance reuse — Pool.make({acquire, size}), Pool.get scoped, instance reuse proven, auto-return on scope close. 69/69 tests, 19 hypotheses, 19 v4 modules.

H20: TxQueue for append-only trail — TxQueue.unbounded + offer + takeAll inside Effect.transaction. Proven: TxQueue + TxRef in SAME transaction = atomic state+trail. 71/71 tests, 20 hypotheses, 20 v4 modules.

H21: Integrated recalc pipeline — Graph topo order + Semaphore throttle + cell dependency eval. Proves full pipeline: dependency sort → throttled concurrent eval → correct values. 72/72 tests, 21 hypotheses, 20 v4 modules.
H22: Effect.withSpan for formula tracing — nested spans (compile → execute), currentSpan access, attributes. Proves formula pipeline is fully traceable. 74/74 tests, 22 hypotheses.

H23: TxHashMap for multi-cell state — TxHashMap + TxRef + TxQueue all in same transaction = atomic cells+stack+trail. TxHashMap.make(...spread) not make([array])! 76/76 tests, 23 hypotheses, 22 v4 modules.

H24 FINAL CAPSTONE: Full FormulaEngine service — Layer.effect composing Cache+Metric+Semaphore+Span+Timeout+forkChild. 8 concurrent evals throttled. 78/78 tests, 24 hypotheses, 22 v4 modules. Architecture COMPLETE.
H7 perf check: 133ms test time (unchanged from baseline 130ms). Zero regression in core eval path despite 24 hypotheses. Full spike validated.
PERF: Hoisted Match dispatch + trail .slice().push() instead of [...spread]. H7 improved 130ms→108ms (-17%). 78/78 tests green. 92K evals/sec.
PERF: Mutable trail push (O(1) per op vs O(n) slice). Marginal on 4-op benchmark but significant for longer formulas. 78/78 green. H7 stable at ~110ms.
H25: Schedule + retry for resilient eval — Schedule.recurs(n) + Effect.retry for transient WASM failures. 80/80 tests, 25 hypotheses, 23 v4 modules.
Stability check — 80/80 green, 923ms wall. No code change. Spike research phase complete.

PRODUCTION EXTRACT: stack-vm.ts service (29KB) + stack-vm.test.ts (49 tests). 3 error channels: VMValue inline (6 codes + display), Effect E (CompileError/EvalError/ResourceError + catchToErrorState), defects. Error propagation, step overflow guard, vmDisplay, utilities.

VM↔Cell bridge: vm-cell-bridge.ts (5KB) + vm-cell-bridge.test.ts (24 tests). Bidirectional VMValue↔CellValue, batch ops, display through VM lens, round-trip checks, error code→display mapping. Empty→0 spreadsheet convention.

DepGraph: dep-graph.ts (9KB) + dep-graph.test.ts (17 tests). Effect v4 Graph topo sort for eval order, cycle detection (CircularDepError), diamond deps, BFS affected set. Walker yields [NodeIndex, N] tuples. Total: 90/90 production tests across 3 modules.
